newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Cullinan details electrical unit reform.
newsitem.headline: Cullinan details electrical unit reform.

text.p: South Africa's Cullinan Holdings Ltd on Wednesday announced a major restructuring of its electrical division.

The group said in a statement that the activities comprising the transmission, distribution and metering business will be transferred to Cullinan Industrial Porcelain and the new structure will operate under the name Cullinan Electrical.
The department known as Cullinan Power Systems will be taken over by Morelay Investments Ltd, an independent company with no legal ties to the Cullinan group, it said.
The group said that all obligations remained intact and not affected by the restructuring, unless so agreed upon.
The restructure follows attempts by Cullinan to sell its electrical division in December to an unnamed buyer, but the negotiations were terminated.
